prompt:
Read the following software requirement and generate a list of clear, testable acceptance criteria.

Requirement:
Users should be able to reset their password using their registered email address.
output: The system provides a 'Forgot Password' option on the login page.
Users can request a password reset by entering their registered email address.
A password reset email is sent to the registered email address.
The password reset link expires after 30 minutes.
Users can create a new password that meets the application's password policy.
The previous password can no longer be used after a successful reset.
An appropriate error message is displayed if an unregistered email address is entered.
